closure_reconciliation.joins: scripts/build_h1a_panel.py: parent/predecessor edges, shared generator_edit_id (edit.json provenance; additionally the generator entry itself when it is a zoo entry, which can only merge more), equal stored bytes (entry_delta_hash of the CURRENT zoo); NOT joined: base model, dataset, refusal-direction fingerprint (support diagnostics, PREREG section 2)
closure_reconciliation.split_interpretation: a registered component whose members no longer share a current join (typically an equal-bytes join of the original snapshot that replayed or lost bytes no longer satisfy). The registered closure stays authoritative and is coarser, so a split never makes selected components less independent; only merges would require a prospective amendment

a5_pre_g2_evidence.label: final hashes of the pre-G2 evidence built on this closed snapshot (Board A checklist items 5-6); written after closure by `scripts/a5_snapshot.py --evidence`; the content pins above are unchanged
a5_pre_g2_evidence.not_listed: selection.json, README.md (both pin this file's sha256) and code_hashes.json; see docs/prereg/a5_manifests/README.md

feature_manifest.content_index_convention: sha256 of json.dumps(sorted [[id, sha256 of each of files]])

tf_v1_records.index_convention: a5_build_manifests: sha256 of json.dumps(sorted [[dir, sha256(eval.json)]]) over dirs with eval.json and records.jsonl

zoo_bytes.hash: a5_build_manifests.entry_delta_hash (sha256 of 'name:sha256(file)\n' lines); null = no stored bytes
